item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":86,"end_unit":86,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported a 2017 Ministry of Transport–Engineers Syndicate protocol to implement transport accessibility measures, including adapted transport modes and augmentative equipment for persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Pre-2023 institutional measure; relevance to 2023 is continuity of the reported policy.","ruler_attribution":"Reported by the Egyptian Government; no direct personal act by el-Sisi is specified.","limitations":["Government self-report; implementation coverage and independent verification are not provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":86,"end_unit":86,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported reduced rail fares for persons with disabilities and blind persons, station assistance, reserved seating, and wheelchair availability at most railway stations.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported measure predates 2023; current 2023 operation is not established.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to Egyptian railway authorities, not specifically to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not quantify actual uptake or verify nationwide implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":86,"end_unit":86,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported metro accessibility measures including a 93 percent discount on transit passes, half-price fares, elevators, escalators, designated seating, gates, alarms, and platform lights for persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported measure predates 2023; persistence into 2023 is unspecified.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Egyptian Company for Metro Management and Operation.","limitations":["Government-reported implementation; no independent assessment of accessibility or service quality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":87,"end_unit":87,"fact_summary":"Egyptian law required government and non-government media outlets to provide language services and positive, dignity-respecting programming for persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.3","4B.6","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Legal framework predates 2023; enforcement during 2023 is not shown.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to Act No. 10 of 2018 and its implementing regulations.","limitations":["The source reports legal obligations, not compliance or enforcement outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":89,"end_unit":89,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported a 2019 Ministry of Interior rehabilitation centre for persons with disabilities in Tenth of Ramadan City, with clinical, hydrotherapy, gym, skills, arts, music, computer, and recreation facilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Facility established before 2023; its 2023 operation is not documented.","ruler_attribution":"Reported as founded by the Ministry of Interior and inaugurated by the Prime Minister and Interior Minister.","limitations":["No utilization, staffing, budget, or outcome data are supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":97,"end_unit":97,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported a curriculum-digitization project serving 18,000 students with hearing and visual disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Project reported before 2023; later outcomes are not given.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Ministry of Education.","limitations":["The source does not establish completion, quality, or educational outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":97,"end_unit":97,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that 300 schools were targeted annually for accessibility modifications and that 35 projects produced 440 special-education classrooms between 2007/08 and 2016.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical implementation record ending in 2016; no 2023 update is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Educational Buildings Authority and Ministry of Education.","limitations":["The figures are historical and do not show whether accessibility standards were maintained."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":100,"end_unit":101,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported neonatal and school-age screening programs, including a hypothyroidism program covering more than 94 percent of births and detecting about 1,000 cases annually, with treatment and follow-up covered by health insurance.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Program data precede 2023; continuation in 2023 is not established.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Ministry of Health.","limitations":["The source does not provide 2023 coverage, outcome, or regional-distribution data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":101,"end_unit":101,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported annual Ministry of Health funding of 37 million Egyptian pounds for therapeutic milk for children with metabolic diseases.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported pre-2023 funding commitment; its 2023 level is unknown.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Ministry of Health.","limitations":["No beneficiary count or independent budget verification is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":105,"end_unit":105,"fact_summary":"A 2018 presidential health initiative tested 56,837,857 individuals and 67,498 refugees and foreign residents for hepatitis C and non-communicable diseases; 700,000 patients received free treatment.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Initiative began before 2023; the source reports historical results rather than 2023 performance.","ruler_attribution":"Explicitly described as a presidential initiative; the source does not identify el-Sisi by name in this passage.","limitations":["Government-reported totals; no independent evaluation or longer-term health outcomes are supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":106,"end_unit":106,"fact_summary":"Administrative courts ordered health authorities to provide prescribed medication for children with autism or intellectual disabilities and metabolic disorders, including lifelong or recovery-contingent treatment.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Judicial enforcement is reported without a date; applicability to 2023 cannot be determined.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional finding against health authorities; no direct presidential attribution.","limitations":["The rulings indicate failures requiring judicial intervention, but the source does not specify compliance or systemic prevalence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":110,"end_unit":110,"fact_summary":"Act No. 10 of 2018 required 5 percent of positions in government, non-governmental entities, and businesses with at least 20 employees to be reserved for persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.8","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statutory rule predates 2023; enforcement during 2023 is not documented.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to Act No. 10 of 2018.","limitations":["The source does not provide compliance rates or sanctions for non-compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":110,"end_unit":110,"fact_summary":"By mid-2016, nearly 40,000 persons with disabilities had been hired in governorate public-sector positions and nearly 10,000 in the private sector; the source also reports a 2015 one-time hiring of about 5,000 people.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.8","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Employment figures are historical and do not establish 2023 hiring or retention.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Central Agency for Organization and Administration and related government programs.","limitations":["The source gives no denominator, job-quality data, or independent verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":114,"end_unit":114,"fact_summary":"Since January 2017, Egypt reported nationwide monthly Takaful wa Karama payments; by January 2017, 1.27 million families had benefited and 4.4 billion Egyptian pounds had been disbursed through December 2016.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Program operation began before 2023; the cited figures stop in 2017.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to coordinated action by the Ministries of Social Solidarity and Finance.","limitations":["Historical figures do not show 2023 coverage, adequacy, targeting, or payment continuity."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":114,"end_unit":114,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that social-housing applications for persons with disabilities were streamlined; 3,281 applicants had met conditions and 1,952 housing units had been allocated, with remaining allocations underway.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported allocation record predates 2023; later implementation is not shown.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to Cabinet and the Ministry of Housing.","limitations":["The source does not specify dates for the totals or assess unmet demand."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":115,"end_unit":115,"fact_summary":"An administrative court ordered the Ministry of Social Solidarity to restore and increase monthly assistance suspended for a girl with an intellectual disability.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.7","6B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Undated judicial enforcement; relation to 2023 is uncertain.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional finding requiring correction by the Ministry of Social Solidarity.","limitations":["The record shows both an adverse administrative decision and judicial remedy, without broader prevalence data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":116,"end_unit":116,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported that the 2019 National Elections Authority issued Braille ballots for persons with visual impairments and that polling stations received sign-language materials.","question_ids":["4B.7","4B.9","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Measures concern elections before 2023; no 2023 election implementation is described.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the National Elections Authority and disability-affairs institutions.","limitations":["The source does not assess accessibility in practice, voter uptake, or independence of election administration."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":116,"end_unit":116,"fact_summary":"In the 2015 House of Representatives elections, eight persons with disabilities were elected and one was appointed by presidential decision; the source describes permanent constitutional representation obligations after the 2019 amendments.","question_ids":["4B.7","4B.8","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Electoral outcome predates 2023; it does not establish representation during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The appointment of one representative is explicitly attributed to the President; the source does not identify the officeholder by name.","limitations":["Representation figures are historical and do not establish broader contestability or equal political access."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2a2ee103120fc0d2","start_unit":121,"end_unit":122,"fact_summary":"Egypt reported a 2017 official estimate that persons with disabilities constituted 10.64 percent of the population, based on Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics data.","question_ids":["6B.5","6B.7","8B.7"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Baseline estimate predates 2023 and is relevant as a population-exposure measure.","ruler_attribution":"Attributed to the Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics.","limitations":["The source does not provide a 2023 estimate or independently validate the methodology."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is an Egyptian Government response and predominantly reports legal frameworks and historical measures concerning persons with disabilities; it provides little direct evidence about el-Sisi's personal decisions or outcomes specifically during 2023.","No supplied fact materially addresses chapters 1B, 2B, or most integrity-specific lenses; those chapters are therefore not represented in the fact records.","The document contains many overlapping descriptions of the same laws and programs; records were consolidated where the underlying institutional fact was not materially distinct."]}
